add.title: Creative Commission
add.text: Gain 5 credits. If you have any click remaining, lose click.

tradeoff: You trade a larger burst payout for an event that is easier to play with little cash. Creative Commission can cost a click if you have not run successfully.
observe: Record when money was missing versus when the smaller payout was insufficient.

cut.title: Retribution
cut.text: Play only if the Runner is tagged. Trash 1 installed program or piece of hardware.

add.title: Anoetic Void
add.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, you may pay 2 credits and trash 2 cards from HQ. If you do, end the run.

tradeoff: You give up a tag-conditional program-trash operation and spend three more influence. Anoetic needs 2 credits and 2 HQ cards to end a run.
observe: Did you draw/install the upgrade, keep the payment available, and actually trigger it?

cut.title: Charm Offensive
cut.text: Run Archives. When that run ends, you may trash 1 rezzed copy of a card you accessed in Archives during that run.

add.title: Leech
add.text: Whenever you make a successful run on a central server, place 1 virus counter on this program. Hosted virus counter: The ice you are encountering gets -1 strength for the remainder of this encounter.

tradeoff: You add another virus tool and give up a draw/damage event. A spare Leech may be less useful than the event you cut.
observe: Record useful Leech encounters, duplicate copies and times you missed the event.

cut.title: Manegarm Skunkworks
cut.text: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they either spend click click or pay 5 credits.

add.title: Ansel 1.0
add.text: Lose click: Break 1 subroutine on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability. Subroutine Trash 1 installed Runner card. Subroutine You may install 1 card from HQ or Archives. Subroutine The Runner cannot steal or trash Corp cards for the remainder of this run.

tradeoff: You replace an upgrade with a bioroid sentry. Keep rez money ready; the Runner can spend clicks to break bioroid subroutines.
observe: Did another sentry protect a scoring lane, or did losing the upgrade make access cheaper?

goal: See the ice-strength lesson more often

cut.title: Underdome Irregulars
cut.text: When your action phase ends, if a piece of ice was rezzed this turn, draw 2 cards or remove 1 tag. If no ice was rezzed this turn, trash this resource.

add.title: The Tungsten Tailor
add.text: Each piece of ice gets -1 strength. The first time each turn you break a subroutine on a piece of ice with 0 or less strength, gain 1 credit.

tradeoff: You trade a conditional resource for a second unique hardware copy. This may improve availability but can leave an unusable duplicate while one is active.
observe: Was Tailor drawn/installed earlier? Did the second copy sit in hand, or was Underdome missed?

cut.title: Marjanah
cut.text: Interface -> 2 credits: Break 1 barrier subroutine. If you made a successful run this turn, this ability costs 1 credit less to use. 1 credit: +1 strength.

add.title: Docklands Pass
add.text: The first time each turn you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.

tradeoff: You trade a copy of a barrier breaker for hardware rewarding HQ access. Keep the other barrier breakers; more accesses do not help if you cannot enter HQ.
observe: Was Docklands drawn and installed? Did extra access matter? Did you miss the breaker?

cut.title: Pantograph
cut.text: +1 mu Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, gain 1 credit. Then, you may install 1 card from your grip. Limit 1 console per player.

add.title: DZMZ Optimizer
add.text: +1 mu The first program you install each turn costs 1 credit less to install.

tradeoff: You trade agenda-triggered draw/install utility for program-install discounts and memory. Keep all Touchstones for Corsair’s stealth-only reduction.
observe: Record when the install discount helped, and when an agenda would have made Pantograph useful.

cut.title: Pharos
cut.text: You can advance this ice. It gets +5 strength while there are 3 or more hosted advancement counters. Subroutine Give the Runner 1 tag. Subroutine End the run. Subroutine End the run.

add.title: Tithe
add.text: Subroutine Do 1 net damage. Subroutine Gain 1 credit.

tradeoff: You trade a large stopping code gate for cheaper taxing/damage ice and spend one more influence. Tithe does not end the run, so retain real stopping ice.
observe: Did lower rez cost matter? Did a Runner pass Tithe where the larger ice would have stopped them?
